channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Robert Williams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Robert Williams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kirk Goldsberry on Robert Williams, Nic Claxton
item.description:
Kirk Goldsberry:

“Nicolas Claxton and Robert Williams III are the names that keep coming up, and I would guess that one of them will be on the Lakers.”

Kirk Goldsberry on Robert Williams, Nic Claxton, Feb 3, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Robert Williams, Robert Williams III
item.description:
Chauncey Billups on Robert Williams III:

“He’s doing good. Getting back out on the court. I’m not sure when he’ll be back but he’s getting better.”

Chauncey Billups on Robert Williams, Robert Williams III, Oct 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Al Horford on Robert Williams
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Al Horford:

“Just a rollercoaster. Just a lot going on. Now we can focus on the season. So grateful to have been able to play with (Robert Williams). He’s a great guy.”

Al Horford on Robert Williams, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Robert Williams
item.description:
Stevens on trading Robert Williams:

“Those the hardest phone calls. It was such a pleasure to watch Rob grow. He had a great attitude. He was a great teammate and got a lot better. That was hard. That was really hard.”

Brad Stevens on Robert Williams, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Robert Williams, Robert Williams III
item.description:
“When (Robert Williams III) was out at the start of the year, those guys that played in his place did an amazing job of keeping us afloat. Blake was as good as it gets both on and off the court.”

Brad Stevens on Robert Williams, Robert Williams III, Aug 30, 2023. Source: Celtics Wire.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Robert Williams
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Robert Williams:

“He's a huge part of our opportunity to be great. I think that that's obvious ... Rob does give us a different dynamic with his ability to play way above the rim on both ends of the floor.”

Brad Stevens on Robert Williams, Jun 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Malcolm Brogdon on Robert Williams
item.description:
Malcolm Brogdon on Robert Williams:

“He's diligent. He's still a young guy, man, that takes his work serious, takes the game serious. Knows how good this team is without him -- and knows how good this team will be with him.”

Malcolm Brogdon on Robert Williams, Dec 16, 2022. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Malcolm Brogdon on Myles Turner, Robert Williams
item.description:
Malcolm Brogdon on Robert Williams:

“I played with a great shot blocker in Myles Turner in Indiana. So to play with another one, I think those are the two best shot blockers in the league. So to play with him this year is going to be amazing.”

Malcolm Brogdon on Myles Turner, Robert Williams, Dec 16, 2022. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Malcolm Brogdon on Robert Williams
item.description:
Brogdon on Robert Williams' return:

“That's huge. We basically have a fully healthy team minus Gallo. I'm super excited ... Rob, I've seen him battle every day trying to get over that injury and he's here now, so we're praying for a healthy season for him. He's going to make a huge impact.”

Malcolm Brogdon on Robert Williams, Dec 16, 2022. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Robert Williams
item.description:
Doncic said another reason for his high praise of Boston is that the Celtics have managed to post the NBA's best record with center Robert Williams III missing the entire season so far following September knee surgery.

“They have one of the best records and they're missing I think a key guy, Williams III,”

Luka Doncic on Robert Williams, Nov 23, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Robert Williams
item.description:
“I didn’t show people I was wearing a brace [off the court] because if I’m out there, if you playing, then you playing. So, if you can’t play, then you can’t play. It was June, so everybody was dealing with something. I wasn’t the only guy out there that was banged up. “[Celtics center] Robert Williams was damn near playing on one leg and I know the Warriors had guys [with] injuries and stuff, so it’s not an excuse. It was just the reality.”

Jayson Tatum on Robert Williams, Oct 5, 2022. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Isaiah Stewart on Al Horford, Robert Williams, Jalen Duren
item.description:
Asked Weaver how Duren fits with Isaiah Stewart:

“They’re different. (Duren) is bigger. His presence is more pronounced. Isaiah has shown to be able to shoot the 3 more. They can play together. Horford and Robert Williams played together … I don’t see it as a challenge.”

Isaiah Stewart on Al Horford, Robert Williams, Jalen Duren, Jun 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Robert Williams
item.description:
Ime Udoka on Rob Williams' health:

“Some days he feels great, some days he doesn't feel as good. That's why we've been so intentional with him. He's truly day-to-day. We never really know until he ramps up before games.”

Ime Udoka on Robert Williams, Jun 9, 2022. Source: Twitter @KeithSmithNBA.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Robert Williams
item.description:
Keith Smith:Stephen Curry:

“They have Robert (Williams) out there. And he's a big part of why their defense is as good as it is. You just know he's back there.”

Stephen Curry on Robert Williams, Jun 9, 2022. Source: Twitter @KeithSmithNBA.

item.title: Mark Williams on Robert Williams
item.description:
one NBAexecutive told HoopsHype following the lottery.

“He’s not quite like Robert Williams. His switch defense isn’t great, but his rim protection, mid-range jump shot and rolling ability is a fit for today’s NBA as a modern big man. He can make a pass after catching it on the short roll as well.”

Mark Williams on Robert Williams, May 20, 2022. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Robert Williams
item.description:
Ime Udoka on Rob Williams and how he's feeling:

“He was great. He's feeling fine. He could have played more honestly.”

Ime Udoka on Robert Williams, Apr 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @KeithSmithNBA.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Robert Williams
item.description:
Ime Udoka on Rob Williams:

“He's getting on court basketball drills, mixing in pretty much everything. No contact, but any basketball drills. Getting a lot of shots up, weight-bearing, strength, agility. It's low level, but he's ramping up day-by-day and feeling good about it.”

Ime Udoka on Robert Williams, Apr 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @KeithSmithNBA.

item.title: Bruce Brown on Robert Williams
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Bruce Brown:

“Them not having Robert Williams is huge. We can attack Theis and Horford in the paint.”

Bruce Brown on Robert Williams, Apr 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Robert Williams
item.description:
Ime Udoka on Robert Williams and optimism he can be back in 4-6weeks:

“There's optimism because the surgery went as well as possible. He'll hit the ground running with two-a-day work tomorrow. It's the best-case scenario, given the injury.”

Ime Udoka on Robert Williams, Mar 30, 2022. Source: Twitter @KeithSmithNBA.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Robert Williams
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Ime Udoka on Robert Williams:

“It was night and day when he was on the court [in Nets series] … [Toe is] something we don’t think is that serious and hopefully he’ll overcome … I’ve talked to him quite a bit … Happy to be on his side now, of the blocked shots and alley oops.”

Ime Udoka on Robert Williams, Jun 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisForsberg_.

item.title: Al Horford on Robert Williams
item.description:
Al Horford on working with Robert Williams:

“I'm going to be in his ear and we're going to be figuring things out together. ... I'm really excited for what's ahead for Rob.”

Al Horford on Robert Williams, Jun 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Robert Williams
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Robert Williams:

“We're trying to keep him off his feet as much as possible on these days away from the game, but he was dressed and went through more of the walkthrough portion of practice but he should be ready to go tomorrow.”

Brad Stevens on Robert Williams, May 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @RedsArmy_John.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Robert Williams
item.description:
John Karalis:Good news from Brad Stevens on Robert Williams:

“Rob went through part of our practice yesterday and looked pretty good”

Brad Stevens on Robert Williams, May 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @RedsArmy_John.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Robert Williams
item.description:
“He makes a big impact on our team. And I think as the season progresses, and this is just another thing that you try to keep in the back of your mind from my seat is like, we need him to be able to play higher minutes as the season gets later. And so right now, I guess you would call that managing (Williams’ playing time) appropriately.”

Brad Stevens on Robert Williams, Feb 23, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Robert Williams
item.description:
Chris Grenham:Jayson Tatum on Robert Williams:

“Rob is continuing to improve night in and night out. ... He has an amazing feel for the game.... Rob is really, really good and he's going to help us the more opportunities he gets.”

Jayson Tatum on Robert Williams, Feb 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Robert Williams
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Robert Williams:

“He's way more comfortable. ... He's getting better at a bunch of the little things. He's obviously a real vertical threat. ... I think it's just a matter of experience and hard work.”

Brad Stevens on Robert Williams, Aug 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.

item.title: Gordon Hayward on Robert Williams
item.description:
Chris Grenham:Gordon Hayward on Robert Williams:

“He's so bouncy and quick off the floor. ... He's also another big that can pass. ... He has a really good feel for the game.”

Gordon Hayward on Robert Williams, Aug 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Robert Williams
item.description:
Chris Grenham:Brad Stevens on Robert Williams:

“You can tell he's been antsy to go for a while now. We're happy he's going to be able to be back.... He may get some minutes tomorrow.”

Brad Stevens on Robert Williams, Feb 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Robert Williams
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Brad Stevens on Robert Williams’ hip soreness that will keep him out tonight:

“From what I’ve been told, it’s a sore hip related to what he had earlier in the season. They’ll continue to monitor that and do some testing on him.”

Brad Stevens on Robert Williams, Dec 9, 2019. Source: Twitter @ChrisForsberg_.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Robert Williams
item.description:
Stevens on Robert Williams coming back from Maine:

“I think Theis’s injury made it so it wouldn’t be, ‘Hey, send him up there for a couple of weeks.’ Or, have him stay up for Sunday’s game, even. We felt like we needed to get him back here.”

Brad Stevens on Robert Williams, Nov 3, 2018. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.
